title: Sand whirlwind
description: Sand whirlwind. Movement animation for a moving obstacle. Choose its role in your story; behaviour is added in GameMaker.
placement: 64 x 64 frames. Origin (32, 64). Use a fixed manual rectangular body mask for all frames. Mask bottom 63 provides a virtual platform contact. Choose a body-only mask for a free-flying or swimming enemy. PNG does not store origin, mask, playback settings or behaviour.
